answer: The nadir multiplier is published, charged in sonnet, and forge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 2977 identities would post 4383 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
